notes.coordinate_system: Every bbox is [left, top, right, bottom] in the original whole JPEG, 1685 × 2359 pixels. Half b begins at original y=1099. Coordinates for half-settled differences and omission blocks are approximate.
notes.H_scope: hua_has=text. H’s note is an editorial summary. Its quoted heading and literal marginal formulas were collated; main text omitted as diplomatic transcription is listed once per paragraph/display. Local C-doubt rows do not double-count those H block omissions.
mathematical_content: The page constructs Lambda^1 and Lambda^2 by adjoining the chord [s,s′] to the two arcs of Gamma; the opening hypothesis places the open chord on the convex-hull boundary and makes s′ visible from s through R²−Gamma.
Lemma XII states that the opposite open arc lies wholly in the interior or exterior of a J-polygon Lambda. The written proof invokes its containment in the complement and its connectedness.
The page then assumes both Lambda^1 and Lambda^2 are J-polygons.

Lemma XIII states an exterior inclusion, with D_x visibly crossed from the display but the preceding intersection sign retained. The pencil note gives an exterior-of-convex-hull formula and inclusion.
The last proof uses E(Lambda^i)⊂E(Gamma) and a chain of exterior supersets. Its final expression visibly has unindexed Lambda.
